chapters.screen: Decision Tree. A tree sorts passengers with yes/no questions about sex, age and fare. Watch it add one question at a time, always the one that separates survivors from the others best, and carve both maps into boxes.
chapters.spoken: Decision Tree. A tree sorts passengers with yes-or-no questions about sex, age and fare. Watch it add one question at a time, always the one that separates survivors from the others best, and carve both maps into boxes.

chapters.screen: Each mark is one passenger: age (x) and fare paid (y, log scale); women on the left, men on the right. Blue dots survived, red crosses did not.
chapters.spoken: Each mark is one passenger: age and fare paid on a log scale; women on the left, men on the right. Blue dots survived, red crosses did not.

chapters.screen: Before any split the tree is one leaf: everyone gets the training survival rate, so nobody is predicted to survive. Circles mark the mistakes.
chapters.spoken: Before any split the tree is one leaf: everyone gets the training survival rate, so nobody is predicted to survive. Circles mark the mistakes.

chapters.screen: Each frame adds the split that cuts Gini impurity the most. Every box on the maps is a leaf, shaded by the share of its training passengers who survived.
chapters.spoken: Each frame adds the split that cuts Gini impurity the most. Every box on the maps is a leaf, shaded by the share of its training passengers who survived.

chapters.screen: 12 leaves: train accuracy 79%, validation 77%. The first question is the most telling: man or woman?
chapters.spoken: 12 leaves: train accuracy 79%, validation 77%. The first question is the most telling: man or woman?

chapters.screen: The unseen passenger answers the questions from the root down to one leaf; the prediction is that leaf's survival share.
chapters.spoken: The unseen passenger answers the questions from the root down to one leaf; the prediction is that leaf's survival share.

chapters.screen: Final exam: the trained model judges all 210 test passengers it has never seen. Wrong calls are circled on the maps and crossed in the grid, grouped by class of travel.
chapters.spoken: Final exam: the trained model judges all 210 test passengers it has never seen. Wrong calls are circled on the maps and crossed in the grid, grouped by class of travel.

chapters.screen: A tree cuts the floor into rectangles with one flat height each, so the sheets are flat terraces. Height is the model's P(survive), one sheet per sex, seen by a swinging camera.
chapters.spoken: A tree cuts the floor into rectangles with one flat height each, so the sheets are flat terraces. Height is the model's chance of survival, one sheet per sex, seen by a swinging camera.

chapters.screen: About the same: 83% with every input against 80% with age, fare and sex.
chapters.spoken: About the same: 83% with every input against 80% with age, fare and sex.

chapters.screen: A tree splits the inputs into boxes with readable questions, and predicts each box's share of survivors. Limitation: its boundaries are boxy steps, and grown deep it memorises small groups of passengers instead of general patterns.
chapters.spoken: A tree splits the inputs into boxes with readable questions, and predicts each box's share of survivors. Limitation: its boundaries are boxy steps, and grown deep it memorises small groups of passengers instead of general patterns.
